Title: Public Preview: MySQL 9.1 Innovation release support

Body.Content:
We're thrilled to announce that Azure Database for MySQL now supports the MySQL 9.1 Innovation release, bringing the latest features to your database experience. This release includes exciting new capabilities, such as JavaScript for stored procedures and vector datatype support, expanding your options for application development and advanced data processing. 

  
This support for the MySQL 9.1 Innovation release gives you access to the latest features and enhancements as they’re introduced, keeping your applications at the forefront of technology. Take advantage of these innovative tools by exploring Azure Database for MySQL today and discovering how you can elevate your database solutions with MySQL 9.1. 

 

Learn more.
